usage: PROG trackio-snapshot [-h] [--dataset-version {v1,v2}]
 [--data-root DATA_ROOT] [--space-id SPACE_ID]

options:
 -h, --help show this help message and exit
 --dataset-version {v1,v2} Which dataset snapshot to publish (default: v1)
 --data-root DATA_ROOT Local data root for artifact storage
 --space-id SPACE_ID Hugging Face Space receiving the run (default: the version's public
 Space)
